passages.text: The wilderness and the land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
passages.sermon:
God will act with power and goodness.
The wilderness will be glad.
The dry land will rejoice.
The desert will blossom like a rose.
passages.original: יְשֻׂשׂ֥וּם מִדְבָּ֖ר וְצִיָּ֑ה וְתָגֵ֧ל עֲרָבָ֛ה וְתִפְרַ֖ח כַּחֲבַצָּֽלֶת׃

passages.text: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
passages.sermon:
God will transform the land.
The land will bloom greatly.
The land will rejoice.
The land will sing with joy.
God will give the land the glory of Lebanon.
God will give the land the splendor of Carmel.
God will give the land the splendor of Sharon.
People will see the glory of the LORD.
People will see the splendor of our God.
passages.original: פָּרֹ֨חַ תִּפְרַ֜ח וְתָגֵ֗ל אַ֚ף גִּילַ֣ת וְרַנֵּ֔ן כְּב֤וֹד הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ נִתַּן־ לָ֔הּ הֲדַ֥ר הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל וְהַשָּׁר֑וֹן הֵ֛מָּה יִרְא֥וּ כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה הֲדַ֥ר אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס

passages.text: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
He sees their weakness.
Some people have limp hands.
Some people have feeble knees.
God commands them.
He says, “Strengthen your weak hands.”
He says, “Steady your feeble knees.”
passages.original: חַזְּק֖וּ יָדַ֣יִם רָפ֑וֹת וּבִרְכַּ֥יִם כֹּשְׁל֖וֹת אַמֵּֽצוּ׃

passages.text: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and just.
God cares for His people.
Some people feel anxious in their hearts.
Speak to these anxious people.
Tell them, “Be strong.
Do not be afraid.
Look, your God will come.
He will come with vengeance.
God will bring divine retribution.
He will come and save you.”
passages.original: אִמְרוּ֙ לְנִמְהֲרֵי־ לֵ֔ב חִזְק֖וּ אַל־ תִּירָ֑אוּ הִנֵּ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ נָקָ֣ם יָב֔וֹא גְּמ֣וּל אֱלֹהִ֔ים ה֥וּא יָב֖וֹא וְיֹשַׁעֲכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
passages.sermon:
God will act with power and mercy.
God will help His people.
God will save them.
God will bring healing.
The eyes of blind people will open.
The ears of deaf people will open.
Blind people will see.
Deaf people will hear.
passages.original: אָ֥ז תִּפָּקַ֖חְנָה עֵינֵ֣י עִוְרִ֑ים וְאָזְנֵ֥י חֵרְשִׁ֖ים תִּפָּתַֽחְנָה׃

passages.text: Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
passages.sermon:
God will come to save His people.
He will bring healing and restoration.
The lame will leap like a deer.
The mute will shout for joy.
Water will burst forth in the wilderness.
Streams will flow in the desert.
passages.original: אָ֣ז יְדַלֵּ֤ג כָּֽאַיָּל֙ פִּסֵּ֔חַ וְתָרֹ֖ן לְשׁ֣וֹן אִלֵּ֑ם כִּֽי־ נִבְקְע֤וּ בַמִּדְבָּר֙ מַ֔יִם וּנְחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲרָבָֽה׃

passages.text: The parched ground will become a pool, the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.
passages.sermon:
God will change the land.
Dry ground will become a pool.
Thirsty land will have springs of water.
Jackals once lived in this place.
Now grass will grow there.
Reeds and papyrus will also grow there.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרָב֙ לַאֲגַ֔ם וְצִמָּא֖וֹן לְמַבּ֣וּעֵי מָ֑יִם בִּנְוֵ֤ה תַנִּים֙ רִבְצָ֔הּ חָצִ֖יר לְקָנֶ֥ה וָגֹֽמֶא׃

passages.text: And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it— only those who walk in the Way— and fools will not stray onto it.
passages.sermon:
God will make a highway.
This highway will be called the Way of Holiness.
Only holy people will walk on this road.
Unclean people will not travel on it.
Fools will not wander onto this road.
Only those who follow God’s way will walk there.
passages.original: וְהָיָה־ שָׁ֞ם מַסְל֣וּל וָדֶ֗רֶךְ וְדֶ֤רֶךְ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִקָּ֣רֵא לָ֔הּ לֹֽא־ יַעַבְרֶ֥נּוּ טָמֵ֖א וְהוּא־ לָ֑מוֹ הֹלֵ֥ךְ דֶּ֛רֶךְ וֶאֱוִילִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִתְעֽוּ׃

passages.text: No lion will be there, and no vicious beast will go up on it. Such will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk upon it.
passages.sermon:
God promises a special road called the Way of Holiness.
No lion will be on this road.
No vicious beast will go up on this road.
No dangerous animal will be found there.
Only the redeemed will walk on this road.
passages.original: לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֨ה שָׁ֜ם אַרְיֵ֗ה וּפְרִ֤יץ חַיּוֹת֙ בַּֽל־ יַעֲלֶ֔נָּה לֹ֥א תִמָּצֵ֖א שָׁ֑ם וְהָלְכ֖וּ גְּאוּלִֽים׃

passages.text: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
passages.sermon:
The redeemed people belong to the LORD.
These redeemed people will return.
They will come to Zion.
They will sing as they come.
Everlasting joy will be on their heads.
They will receive gladness.
They will receive joy.
Sorrow will leave them.
Sighing will leave them.
passages.original: וּפְדוּיֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה יְשֻׁב֗וּן וּבָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּרִנָּ֔ה וְשִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֑ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְשִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂ֔יגוּ וְנָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַאֲנָחָֽה׃פ
